name.en: Lumelar P45-PS Stand Mixer Pouring Shield, Clear One-Piece Shield with Chute for Adding Ingredients, Keeps Flour Inside, Fits Lumelar Tilt-Head and Bowl-Lift Mixers

description.en: A clear one-piece shield that keeps flour and splashes inside the bowl. The chute lets you add ingredients while the mixer runs.
description.pt-BR: Protetor transparente de peça única que mantém farinha e respingos dentro da tigela. O bocal deixa adicionar ingredientes com a batedeira ligada.
